mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 64 degrees with overcast conditions near the Verona Area High School, under the light of a Waning Gibbous moon.

The city has announced that a segment of Highway M will be closed from October 6 to October 9 for milling and asphalt work near the new Aldi location, so please plan your detours via Old PB, East Verona Avenue, and South Main Street.

There is plenty to do in Verona today, including the Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory, with more music events and markets coming throughout the week.

In a report from September 24, officers responded to a collision between a vehicle and a bicyclist at Westward Drive and Jenna Drive involving an eleven-year-old child who luckily did not require hospitalization.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Double Strawberry, and you can head over when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
